engine_name: ReValue Malaysia RM Valuation Engine v0.1

methodology.market_value_range_rm: Malaysia consumer resale / fair market range based primarily on exact-model comparable asking-market evidence.
methodology.trade_in_benchmark_rm: Dealer/shop/trade-in indicative benchmark; not the same as consumer resale value.
methodology.repair_cost_range_rm: Repair-cost evidence shown separately; not automatically subtracted from market value.
methodology.range_rule: Prefer Q1-Q3 robust ranges. For damaged scenarios with weak exact-defect evidence, widen the condition-group range and lower confidence instead of inventing a defect coefficient.
methodology.outlier_handling: No eligible v0.2 rows were silently removed. Parts-only/faulty examples remain classified as functional_defect and are not used as working damaged-phone comparables.
methodology.confidence_rule: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW based on exact-model count, condition-matched count, and exact-defect evidence.

source_dataset.name: Kaggle Used Phones & Tablets Pricing Dataset
source_dataset.license: CC0 Public Domain per original Kaggle source metadata

target_check.documented_meaning: normalized price of the used/refurbished device in euros
target_check.formula_status: No authoritative inverse formula was found in the accessible Kaggle/mirror metadata.
target_check.modeling_decision: Train and evaluate on normalized_used_price only; do not convert predictions to Malaysian Ringgit.
target_check.log_scale_note: The numeric scale is consistent with a log-like normalized price because exp(value) gives plausible euro price magnitudes, but this report does not rely on an undocumented inverse transformation.

phase2_base_model.phase3_usage: Evidence of a real general used-device value model and secondary sanity check only; not directly converted into Malaysia RM.
